card.title: Vanilla's ancient and modern origins
card.body: Vanilla was first isolated as a pure substance in 1858 by Théodore Nicolas Gobley. Traces of vanillin were found in jars from Canaan dating to the 2nd millennium BCE. Vanillin was first synthesized in 1874 by Ferdinand Tiemann and Wilhelm Haarmann from coniferin in pine bark.
